Queen Poppy is the relentlessly optimistic, pink-haired protagonist of the DreamWorks Trolls franchise, voiced by Anna Kendrick. Born at the Troll Tree as the daughter of King Peppy, her early life was defined by the Pop Trolls' escape from the Troll-hungry Bergens.The Last Trollstice EscapePoppy was born into a world of fear where the Bergens kept the Trolls caged in a tree, eating them once a year during a holiday called "Trollstice" to experience temporary happiness. On the day baby Poppy was chosen to be eaten by Prince Gristle Jr., the Trolls executed a massive escape plan. King Peppy led his people to safety through underground tunnels under the vow "No Troll left behind".The Hidden Secret: Sister VivaDuring the chaotic escape from the Troll Tree, the underground tunnels collapsed. This catastrophe separated a faction of the Trolls from the main group. Among those cut off was Poppy’s older sister, Viva. Believing Viva and the others were lost forever, a heartbroken King Peppy chose never to speak of her. Because Poppy was an infant during the escape, she completely forgot she had a sister, growing up as an only child in the newly built Pop Village. Her mother was also absent from her life from a very young age.Life in Pop VillageSheltered from the truth of the world and the remaining musical tribes, Poppy grew up believing that life was strictly about singing, dancing, scrapbooking, and hourly hugs. She was known to be eager and over-enthusiastic from the start—allegedly singing before she could talk and dancing before she could crawl. This safe, bubbly environment fueled her naive perspective that every problem could be solved with a song or a hug.Adulthood and LeadershipPoppy's backstory sets up her growth across the film franchise:Trolls: 20 years after the escape, she risks her life to rescue her friends from Bergen Town, ultimately making peace between the two species by showing them they can find happiness within themselves.
